class: A keyword chose the wrong kind of answer: a settled Yes/No was typed into a free-text box that asks the owner to specify
symptom: Color Health (CareerPuck): 'If you will require the company's assistance or sponsorship for work authorization, please specify the type (e.g., H-1B transfer, TN, ...)' was filled with 'Yes'. The correct answer (H-1B) was proposed afterwards but could not replace it, and the run handed over with 'could not set'.
root_cause: page_agent._STANDING_ANSWERS matched the bare word 'sponsor' (and 'relocat' and others) in any question and answered a boolean profile fact with Yes or No whatever the control was. A free-text box that asks to specify, describe or explain wants a value, not a yes or no.
why_tests_missed: Standing-answer tests used yes/no controls (radios, selects) or clearance questions. None gave a text box a question that contained a standing keyword but asked for detail.
fix: known_answer skips a boolean standing answer when the control is a free-text box with no options and the question asks to specify, describe, explain, elaborate or list, or asks what type; the question then goes to the planner.
prevention: Decide the kind of answer from the control and the question's verb (whether / specify / describe) before reaching for a topic keyword; a topic keyword alone never decides the answer.
